title: Manual check in the DAW: chop-shop, salamander-beat, minor-line, voice-layer
description:
## Intent

Prove M2 in the DAW.

## Steps (manual, the owner with the DAW)

1. Export `examples/chop-shop.apr`, `examples/salamander-beat.apr`, `examples/minor-line.apr`, `examples/voice-layer.apr` with `apricity export --daw-set … -o /tmp/daw/<name>.als`.
2. Open each; check kit hits named by pad, voiced chords complete (group with numbered audio tracks), reversed hits backwards, the voice re-pitched.
3. A/B against `apricity render <score> -o /tmp/daw/<name>.wav`: same notes and timing (mix still differs until M3).

## Verification

A comment with the DAW version and each result; mismatches filed as bugs under this epic.

## Release

No commit.
